{"id":1895949431,"question_id":4171,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 4 weeks","timestamp":1769310103,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1895949431/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Rotate Non Negative Elements","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> rotateElements(vector<int>& nums, int k) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        vector<int>positives;\n        for(auto it : nums) if(it > 0) positives.push_back(it);\n\n        if(positives.empty()) return nums;\n        int rightshift = k % positives.size();\n        int leftshift = (positives.size() - rightshift) % positives.size();\n        \n        reverse(positives.begin(), positives.end());\n        reverse(positives.begin(), positives.begin() + leftshift);\n        reverse(positives.begin() + leftshift, positives.end());\n\n        vector<int>ans(n);\n        for(int i =0 ; i< n ; i++){\n            if(nums[i] > 0) ans[i] = INT_MIN;\n            else ans[i] = nums[i];\n        }\n\n        int idx = 0;\n        for(int i =0 ; i< n ; i++){\n            if(ans[i] == INT_MIN)\n            {\n                ans[i] = positives[idx++];\n            }\n        }\n    return ans;\n        \n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"rotate-non-negative-elements","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1554}
